summary: Bootstrap publication tools in pip-less UV environments

delivery.outcome: Make shared publication tool preparation work in supported pip-less UV project environments without lock mutation or false installation success.
nonGoals: No transport replacement or registry upload in tests
No fallback to a different interpreter or lock-capable uv sync
No version changes in this application slice; packaging integration owns the next material release

architecture.decision: Reuse the existing shared publication dependency boundary for both tools. Prefer UV pip with the exact interpreter, retain bounded interpreter-local pip compatibility when UV is absent, and recheck installed tools before any build/upload. Return failure without printing potentially credential-bearing installer diagnostics.
architecture.rollback: Protected source revert; no data migration and no published artifact replacement.

commands: Real pip-less tool bootstrap canary after accepted packaging integration
